title: Measurement 1 Redo: Concentration & Latency Budget over the Full Extended Day (A8.2 tick-anchor resumption)
approval: Cooper reviewed and approved in-session 2026-08-01 (alongside a confirmation of phase-7-approved); formally recorded here, tagged phase-6b-approved. Per the phase_6b approval gate and the phase-6c digest note, master fast-forwards at this tag - the first landing on master since phase-5a-approved (the 6b line contains phase_6 -> 6b -> 6c -> 7 -> the A8.2 tick-anchor resumption). The latency-budget reading from chart 04 (gap-inclusive primary 516 min vs RTH-intraday rth_legacy 52 min) is Cooper's, recorded at the gate.
baseline: phase-7-approved (phase/6b fast-forwarded onto it - the A8.2 resumption requires D4, the t8 canonical view, and the approved 6c/7 docs, none of which existed at the A6.1 stop)
summary: Resumed Phase 6b under Amendment 8 (A8.2, prompts/phase_6b_amendment_8.md, Cooper-approved 2026-07-28). A6.2: swept research/phase_6b/ + config for spine numerics (13 prev_close hits, all measurement-path), reworked the opportunity-decay anchor from the D4-quarantined spine prev_close to the tick-derived tick_close_t_minus_1_rth (sweep 13->0), re-validated on the dev tier, re-froze the config. A6.3a: the single budgeted full pass over filtered_trades (4.95B rows, 24.75 min, 0 spill) materialized event_minute_bars_v2 (45,925,350 rows, extended-day, tz-aware) - distinct T=0 = 15,763, v1 subset of v2, integrity clean, tz ET-vs-UTC mismatch 0/4.04B. A8.2's dup-print counter (reworked to HLL approx after an exact COUNT(DISTINCT) blew up 350GB/2.5h and was killed) flagged 9 events >5%; an exact recheck confirmed 7 real duplicate-print events (2022-01 SCWO/CETY/NUKK) + 2 HLL artifacts - a genuine, previously-undetected data-quality finding, disposed flag-and-proceed by Cooper (2026-07-29). A6.3b/c: extended-day measurements + charts 01-07.

surprises: rth_legacy crossing = 52 min reproduces Phase 6's RTH-only 52 EXACTLY - the tick-anchor rework didn't disturb the RTH-comparable measurement

primary (gap-inclusive) crossing 516 min (~12:36 ET) is far later than rth_legacy 52 - the prior-close anchor puts the overnight gap in the denominator, so the intraday move is a smaller fraction of the total
A8.2's dup-print requirement found a real, previously-undetected data-quality issue (7 events with exact-duplicate prints in filtered_trades) - the requirement did exactly its job
high time-of-day is strongly structured (09:30-open + 16:00-close spikes), and premarket volume is a real distribution (not a collection 0-spike)
